summary: The proof passes sequential, text-only verification. The statement is self-contained, and no hard-prohibition violation was found. Section 2 correctly proves regularity, ramification, and integral vanishing after inverting x; its Dennis–Stein sign convention and identification with unit products agree with [Weibel, Chapter III, Sections 5.11–5.12](https://sites.math.rutgers.edu/~weibel/Kbook/Kbook.III.pdf). Section 3 constructs a map from actual relative K-theory without identifying actual groups tensored with Q_3 with completed homotopy groups. Its reconstruction of module compatibility follows the maps and equivalences in [AMMN, Sections 2 and 4, especially Proposition 4.10](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2003.12541v2), together with the [multiplicative cyclotomic trace](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1103.3923) and the [module-compatible norm construction](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1707.01799). The finite-dimensional normalized HKR calculation, completion argument, and universal-unit normalization give the asserted logarithmic character. The identification of the norm with Connes B and the cyclic module formula are supported by [Hoyois, Section 2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1506.07123v2) and [Bökstedt–Ottosen, Section 2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1601.07412v2). Section 4 proves its residue criterion in the ordinary differential quotient: the chart transitions, convergence of the Laurent residue, and cancellation imposed by closedness are valid. Section 5 correctly constructs the map to B and the affine-line torsor describing its special fiber. Homotopy invariance, descent, and the [projective bundle formula](https://sites.math.rutgers.edu/~weibel/Kbook/Kbook.V.pdf), combined with [Quillen's finite-field computation, Weibel IV.1.13](https://sites.math.rutgers.edu/~weibel/Kbook/Kbook.IV.pdf), give actual K_4(C)=0 and hence the required injection. Section 6 correctly computes the character modulo exact forms; the endpoint series converges, its initial term is 4 after division by u, and every tail term lies in 3 Z_3. This proves nonvanishing and infinite order, which transfer to both source rings. Integral localization vanishing then gives the asserted rational failure of injectivity. Section 7 consistently retains ordinary homology and verifies the stated non-Hausdorff phenomenon without replacing any image by its closure.
